# University Library | Illinois

> The University of Illinois Library provides comprehensive access to collections, research guides, and library spaces across campus with integrated discovery tools and specialized services.

The University Library serves the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign community with physical locations, digital collections, research support through LibGuides, and resource discovery via catalog systems like I-Share and ExLibris. The library is undergoing a capital campaign to transform its Archives and Special Collections building, opening fall 2027.

## Key Topics

- I-Share catalog system
- Digital Collections
- LibGuides research guides
- Interlibrary Loan
- Library spaces and study rooms
- Special Collections and Archives
- EBSCOhost article access
- Catalog discovery
- Library hours and locations
- DEIA and accessibility
- Main Library
- Grainger Engineering Library
- Book and journal search
- Staff directory
- Library facilities

## Getting Started

- [University Library Homepage](https://www.library.illinois.edu): Main entry point for library search, catalog discovery, and resource access
- [About the Library](https://www.library.illinois.edu/about): Library overview with hours, staff directory, spaces, and strategic planning information
- [Libraries & Hours](https://www.library.illinois.edu/library-hours): Library locations, hours, and facilities directory for all campus libraries

## Collections & Discovery

- [Collections](https://www.library.illinois.edu/collections): Library collections, special collections, digital collections, and acquisition services
- [LibGuides Research Guides](http://guides.library.illinois.edu): Subject guides, research guides, and librarian assistance resources for academic research
- [Sensitive Content Statement](https://www.library.illinois.edu/collections/sensitive-content-statement): Library policy on sensitive content in digital collections and archival materials

## Library Spaces & Facilities

- [Using Library Spaces Overview](https://www.library.illinois.edu/using-library-spaces): Guide to library spaces, study rooms, reservations, and facility usage
- [Archives and Special Collections Building Campaign](https://www.library.illinois.edu/specialcollectionsbuilding): Capital campaign to transform the Archives and Special Collections building with fall 2027 opening

## Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

- [Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Accessibility](https://www.library.illinois.edu/geninfo/deia): Library's DEIA framework, accessibility commitments, and institutional policies

## News & Updates

- [Library News](https://www.library.illinois.edu/news): Library news and updates on services, partnerships, and funding initiatives

## Staff & Support

- [Staff Directory](https://www.library.illinois.edu/geninfo/staff-directory): Library staff directory and employee contact information lookup
- [Staff Directory (People)](http://www.library.illinois.edu/people): Staff directory and employee contact information for University Library

## Optional

- [Faculty & Staff Achievements](https://www.library.illinois.edu/about/faculty-staff-achievements): Recognition of faculty and staff awards, grants, publications, and achievements
